title: Salt and Spire
author: Petra Zhou
blurb: Jonah Hartwell, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
